text:
Yes. Aftermarket back-seat screens exist for the Model Y, and Tesla doesn't sell one. Which to buy depends on your model year and what you want it for.

## Option 1: Rear touchscreen (most common)
These are 8.66" Android screens that mount on the back of the center console. They stream video, support wireless CarPlay/Android Auto, and control rear A/C and seat heating.

- **Best-reviewed with real volume:** the 8.66" Android 13 unit with 4GB+64GB, at $329.99 (3.9 stars, 41 reviews). It's on [Amazon's search page](https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-rear-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+rear+screen), and the listing says "Only 9 left in stock."
- **Cheaper:** a Qualcomm-processor unit at $279.99 (4.5 stars, but only 2 reviews) and the Tlyard at $210.99 (1 review, delivery Nov 4-13). Both are on the same [Amazon results](https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-back-seat-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+back+seat+screen), but with so few reviews I'd treat them as a gamble.
- **Brand-direct:** the [TESERY 8.66" screen](https://www.tesery.com/products/tesery-8-66-inch-rear-entertainment-display-screen-for-tesla) is $359 (4.7 stars, 22 reviews), with a 30-day return policy. Its fit list says Model Y 2020 to March 2025.

**Caveats:** Reviews are mixed. Tesery buyers mention lag, a screen that keeps entering child-lock mode, and apps that won't finish updating. One reviewer still called it fine for a kid. The Amazon ratings are mostly 3.2 to 3.9 stars. Expect a decent but not polished product, and buy from a seller with an easy return window. Wi-Fi hotspot and CarPlay also can't run at the same time on the Tesery.

Another option, the Aear 8.8" at SquareWheels, is [currently sold out](https://squarewheelsauto.com/products/rear-entertainment-screen-for-tesla-model-y).

## Option 2: Projector screen for parked movie nights
The [Aurzen TravelPlay AutoCinema Screen](https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y) is $119.99. It's a clip-in screen and sunshade for the **2025-2026 Model Y**, with no wiring. You need your own projector, and it's for parked use only. On 2020-2024 cars it only works in roof mode, and the rear panel doesn't fully cover the window. A third-party deal site says the code CJ10 took about $12 off in its test on Oct 24 ([source](https://dealectric.com/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-tesla-model-y)). That site earns an affiliate commission, so check the final price at checkout.

## My recommendation
- **2019-2024 Model Y, and you want a screen for kids:** get the $329.99 Android 13 unit on Amazon. It has the most reviews, and Amazon returns are easy.
- **2025+ "Juniper" Model Y:** I'd be careful. Most of the rear screens above list fits only through 2024 or early 2025, so confirm Juniper compatibility with the seller before ordering. The Aurzen screen is the one product here made for that model.
- **Only occasional movie nights while parked:** the Aurzen screen plus a portable projector.

What model year is your Model Y, and is this mainly for kids on road trips? That would let me narrow it down.
